default/32773.htm.text: Officer Jakan: The day that our fleet all went down in the Seed of Annihilation... I could hear the screams of my subordinates as they disappeared, but I had to leave them all behind and escape from that place with Ermian. Still, even as a soldier, I don't regret my decision. But I can't help but f…

links.text: Listen to his story about the Seed of Annihilation.

default/32773-1.htm.text: Officer Jakan: Ugh, where should I begin? There's a lot to say about this place, none of it good. But if you want to survive here, you'd do well to listen. The Seed of Annihilation is crawling with psychotic monsters unlike anything you've seen before. There are three clans... or races really, I ca…

default/32773-2.htm.text: Officer Jakan: The Bistakon... well, the Bistakon are the one clan in this seed that most resembles the race of man. However, they are a twisted reflection of the most bestial motives and intentions within man's heart. They are wont to acts of extreme violence, tearing their prey limb from limb. Th…

default/32773-3.htm.text: Officer Jakan: Well, the Cokrakon... they might be the strangest of the life forms in this Seed. From a distance, you might mistake one for a man, but up close, their true form is revealed. Their appearance and behavior resembles that of territorial birds of prey. As with the other clans, they are …

default/32773-4.htm.text: Officer Jakan: The Reptilikons were the most familiar to us when we crashed here because they superficially resemble the Lizardmen clans. However, as I said, the resemblence is purely superficial. They don't seem to have any advanced social structure beyond the tendency to travel in herds and devou…

Q00452_FindingtheLostSoldiers/32773-0.ht.text: Officer Jakan: Unless you've commanded men in battle, I doubt you could understand my mental state just now. I was forced to abandon most of my soldiers during the crash to save my life and those who near me. It weighs heavily on my heart. Death hangs over this land like the sky. I can see in your …

Q00452_FindingtheLostSoldiers/32773-1.ht.text: Officer Jakan: Unless you've commanded men in battle, I doubt you could understand my mental state just now. I was forced to abandon most of my soldiers during the crash to save my life and those who near me. It weighs heavily on my heart, which is why I've been making a request to travelers who've…

Q00452_FindingtheLostSoldiers/32773-4.ht.text: Officer Jakan: If you don't think you'll make it through the Seed of Annihilation alive, I will not fault you for giving up now. But if that's not the case, enter the Seed and bring back my soldiers or whatever evidence of them you can find. An ID tag would be ideal.

Q00452_FindingtheLostSoldiers/32773-5.ht.text: Officer Jakan: Ah, you're back and in one piece. I see... though this soldier didn't make it alive, at least we know his name now. If it weren't for you, the names of the dead for the sake of Gracia would not be remembered. Thanks to you, he'll receive the eternal rest he deserves and his family wi…

Q00452_FindingtheLostSoldiers/32773-6.ht.text: Officer Jakan: You did a good job, something to be proud of. I'm sure you're tired. You should get some rest. (This quest can be taken once a day and is reset at 6:30am)

Q00452_FindingtheLostSoldiers/32773-2.ht.text: Officer Jakan: It is simple. I'd like to know what happened to the soldiers I left behind. Save those that might still be alive, but if not, at least bring back their ID tag so we can identify and remember the dead.

Q00452_FindingtheLostSoldiers/32773-3.ht.text: Officer Jakan: Thank you so much. A Gracian soldier might return home, or at the very least, might be remembered for his sacrifice thanks to your help.
